DIAGNOSIS READY: DRESS Syndrome (Drug Reaction with Eosinophilia and Systemic Symptoms)

The clinical picture of fever, itchy rash, and joint pain appearing after antibiotic therapy is classic for this severe drug reaction. The previous lab results were likely normal at the early onset of symptoms, so the diagnosis relies on the specific history of drug exposure and systemic involvement rather than appendicitis.
